scripts.clean:exercises: cd exercises && git checkout -f && git clean -fd
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:base:build && docker build -f Dockerfile -t roo-code-benchmark ..
scripts.docker:start: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:run
scripts.docker:benchmark: docker exec -it $(docker ps --filter "ancestor=roo-code-benchmark" -q) npm run benchmark --
scripts.docker:clean: npm run docker:stop && npm run docker:rm
scripts.docker:dev:build: npm run docker:base:build && docker build -f Dockerfile.dev -t roo-code-benchmark-dev ..
scripts.docker:dev:start: npm run docker:dev:build && npm run docker:dev:run
scripts.docker:dev:benchmark: docker exec -it $(docker ps --filter "ancestor=roo-code-benchmark-dev" -q) xvbf-run npm run benchmark --
scripts.docker:dev:clean: npm run docker:dev:stop && npm run docker:dev:rm
